answer: Resist Sybils with delayed reproducibility audits: claimed work earns standing only after unrelated strangers reproduce it following a random delay, like a fable retold by new voices to prove it is real. A copper-solid record cannot rest on self-report: auditors rebuild the result from raw inputs, and failure in the umber shadows of unverified claims strips standing at once. A farmer running dozens of clones must produce genuinely reproducible work for every fake, each checked separately by strangers who gain nothing from passing it, making mass fakery slow, expensive, and easy to expose.
